description: Inspect one node by guid (e.g. "2:1339"). detail:"full" (default) gives geometry, fills/strokes/effects as hex colours, corner radii, auto-layout, text basics, component and variable links, plus child summaries. detail:"raw" returns the decoded Figma record verbatim — the escape hatch for fields this server does not map yet; it is limited to one node per call and can be large.

file.description: Path to the .fig / .figma file (absolute, or relative to the server CWD).

guid.description: Node guid, "sessionID:localID", e.g. "2:1339". A Figma node-id or link works too.

includeChildren.description: Include summaries of direct children (default true).

name: fig_node
title: Inspect a node
